W3 planters leave the existing garden gate approach clear
low planter tops support approaching feet and release them on exit

view switching preserves the body and collision position
station local/world coordinates round-trip at its nonzero placement

camera collision never scans rendered triangles

look.method: Actual pipeline uniforms/parameters and UI state; central-pixel nonblack smoke checks. Images retain animation.

limits: Town strength0 affects terrain/meadow only, not city foliage or gravel; not a full C15 restoration.
Pixel diffs are final encoded RGB; causal attribution additionally needs shader/object observations.
Fixed repeats are not performance or walking tests.
Normal startup long frames are preserved, without causal attribution or repeat-to-green.
CPU lifecycle isolation is tested separately in the same realm; this GPU session initializes one look and cannot establish cross-look GPU leak freedom.
